data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to use Google's ML Kit document scanner API to digitize physical documents.
data.what_it_does: Allows users to convert physical documents into digital formats using Google's ML Kit document scanner API. Provides a high-quality UI flow with automatic capture, edge detection, cropping, and filtering.
use_when: You need to scan physical documents on Android with built-in edge detection and cropping.
You want a consistent UI flow for document capture powered by Google Play services.
avoid_when: You need robust iOS document scanning support, as the feature is currently only available for Android.
You need to run document scanning on the web or other unsupported platforms.
strengths: High-quality and consistent user interface for digitizing physical documents.
No camera permission is required from your app since it leverages Google Play services.
weaknesses: Feature is still in Beta and is only available for Android.
Relies on Google Play services being available on the target device.
data.setup_notes: Requires Android minSdkVersion 21, compileSdkVersion 36, and targetSdkVersion 36.
data.minimal_example:
final documentScanner = DocumentScanner(options: DocumentScannerOptions());
DocumentScanningResult result = await documentScanner.scanDocument();
